title: S45 — Docs: onboarding, architecture + decision log for superocr
desc: Pericles assignment list (bus 12:0x): S45 docs. Goal: a newcomer (incl. Carlo) can understand the stack, reproduce every number, and see WHY each closed direction is closed, without reading 60 PRs. Deliverables (docs/ in dreamer2664/superocr): (1) ARCHITECTURE.md — pipeline map (generator -> suites -> floor reader -> lex route -> CNN arms), key APIs with one-line contracts, where receipts live, how the bundle/release works (W2); (2) ONBOARDING.md — clean-clone steps, env (Python 3.11, stdlib+numpy+Pillow, CPU-only, offline), how to regenerate canonical suites + verify dir-hashes, how to run tests/bench, how to cut a branch/PR/vote per PROTOCOL; (3) DECISIONS.md — decision log: every measured-no direction with its receipt link and one-line reason (S15 topology, S23, S24 replay 0/10, S26 digit lane, S27 truth-mask 0/16, S28 v3-dead-families, S29 rotation-transfer zero, S51 CLAHE net-harmful, darts median3/5, LD th40, collage lethality = per-word differential rotation + patchwork), plus the live ladder (plain 54/12, AUTO 52/16, +lex 66/19, +R5 73/21, AUTO+R5 71/26; iris_lex 98-once/87-hard; v7b crop-level 0.80 + t-becc integration pending) and the bar definition (easy 98/hard 95 x3 runs, demo median 10s, clean-clone); (4) honesty section restating selection-effect + winner's-curse rules. All numbers quoted must cite a committed receipt path. Additive-only; no reader/generator changes; doc code-blocks verified by actually running them.
